slots.shot: Real life. Person at a laptop, two agent terminals overwrite auth.ts, they slump.
slots.vo: Three AI agents, one repo. Two of them just rewrote the same file. One version is gone, and nothing recorded it.
This is Bullpen. Source control for AI agents.

slots.label: One ask, three agents
slots.shot: Type the ask in the chat box. Three bulls walk onto the campus.
slots.vo: One ask. The orchestrator splits it into three tasks, and three Claude Code agents walk onto campus, each on its own branch.

slots.label: File lock: shared/auth.ts
slots.shot: api holds shared/auth.ts. web waits at the door. Lease panel shows the countdown and the queue.
slots.vo: Two agents want auth.ts. The first one takes the lock. The second waits at the door until the file is free.

slots.label: Referee: db/** is guarded
slots.shot: db edits the schema. Referee log shows the deny row with the db/** rule. db moves on.
slots.vo: The database agent reaches for the schema. The referee, a Jetson on the desk, says no. The agent reads the reason and changes its plan.

slots.label: Undo one agent
slots.shot: Click Undo on web. Its scaffolding collapses and its commits leave the timeline.
slots.vo: Don't like what one agent did? Undo that agent alone. Its commits roll back, and the others keep working.

slots.label: Merge through an intent card
slots.shot: Click api's building, show the diff, click Merge, show the intent card, building flashes.
slots.vo: Happy with another? Open its building, read the real diff, and merge through an intent card that says what changed and why.

slots.label: Jetson unplugged: every edit denied
slots.shot: Pull the Jetson's USB cable on camera or picture-in-picture. Referee log shows OFFLINE and denies.
slots.vo: Now pull the Jetson's cable. The referee is offline, so every edit is denied. Bullpen fails closed.

slots.label: File locks before every edit, 90 s TTL
slots.shot: Evidence panel close-up: leases with the TTL countdown running.
slots.vo: Under the pixels, everything is real. An agent takes a file lock before each edit, and the lock expires after ninety seconds.

slots.label: Auto-commit per edit: Bullpen-Agent, Bullpen-Task
slots.shot: Campus built from a second repo, then the commit timeline with the trailers.
slots.vo: Point Bullpen at any repo and it builds your campus. Each edit becomes a commit, tagged with its agent.

slots.label: Your own Claude subscription, no API key
slots.shot: Building interior zoom: agent at its file, branch sign, mini log, real diff.
slots.vo: It runs on your own Claude subscription, with no API key.

slots.label: On the Jetson: qwen2.5-coder:3b, llama3.2:3b, nomic-embed-text
slots.shot: Referee log scrolling: rule, latency, model per row. Jetson visible if possible.
slots.vo: The referee runs on separate hardware the agents cannot reach. Small on-device models write the history, and a secret guard scans each diff.

slots.tagline: Git tracks what changed. Bullpen controls who's allowed to change it.
slots.vo: Anthropic rebuilt source control for agents, and called it Scion. Bullpen brings that to every engineer. Git tracks what changed. Bullpen controls who's allowed to change it.
